candidate.name: intraday_open_reference_directional_occupancy_240m
candidate.formula: let p0=open_09_31; for every selected close c_i compute sign(log(c_i/p0)); return the arithmetic mean of all 240 fixed-support signs
candidate.source_grid: validate the exact 241-row Tushare grid, then use exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00; exclude 09:30 and the lunch transition
candidate.support: the 09:31 open and all 240 selected closes must be finite and strictly positive
candidate.zero_semantics: an exact equality c_i=p0 contributes zero; it remains in the fixed 240-bar denominator and is never dropped or bridged
candidate.reference_semantics: the single 09:31 raw open is fixed for the whole stock-session; no VWAP, previous close, fitted anchor, tolerance or future field enters

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: late_return_30m
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: It is a signed endpoint return over the last 30 minutes. Campaign110 counts the whole-session occupation time on either side of a fixed 09:31 opening reference and is unchanged by return magnitudes away from that reference.

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_signed_path_efficiency_239m
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: It divides endpoint displacement by total absolute close-to-close path length. Campaign110 has no path-length denominator and uses 240 ternary position states relative to one fixed opening reference.

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_half_session_chord_adherence_240m and intraday_morning_afternoon_return_profile_persistence_119p
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: Those mechanisms evaluate deviations from fitted endpoint chords or similarity between half-session return profiles. Campaign110 fits no chord, compares no profiles and preserves only above/equal/below states against one opening anchor.

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_close_range_occupancy_entropy_10b and intraday_own_bar_close_location_entropy_10b_240m
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: Those are direction-neutral entropies over coarse global-range or own-bar locations. Campaign110 uses no high/low, no bins and retains directional occupation relative to the session opening reference.

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_cumulative_vwap_crossing_rate_240m
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: The Candidate49 mechanism counts crossings around a time-varying cumulative amount-weighted VWAP. Campaign110 reads no amount or volume, uses one fixed raw opening anchor, and measures occupation rather than crossing frequency.

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_continuous_session_net_return_reversal_240m
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: It is a bounded contrarian transform of the first-to-last continuous-session endpoint displacement. Campaign110 freezes the continuation direction and can differ when identical endpoints are reached through different occupation paths.

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_global_price_range_revisit_240m and intraday_extreme_arrival_order_240m
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: Those use high/low frontier revisits or the ordering of global extremes. Campaign110 forbids high/low and depends only on how long closes remain on each side of the opening reference.

nearest_mechanism_distinctions.name: intraday_intrabar_body_magnitude_serial_persistence_238p
nearest_mechanism_distinctions.distinction: Campaign109 correlates adjacent absolute open-to-close body magnitudes. Campaign110 neither correlates nor measures body magnitude; only the 09:31 open is used and all later opens are irrelevant.

full_family_review.close_path_endpoint_and_return_families: distinct by fixed-opening-reference ternary occupation over all 240 closes rather than return magnitude, endpoint, path length, serial dependence, spectrum or weak order
full_family_review.range_wick_close_location_and_body_famil: distinct because high/low and all later opens are forbidden
full_family_review.amount_volume_transaction_price_and_vwap: distinct because activity and transaction-price fields are forbidden
full_family_review.market_cross_section_and_day_over_day_fa: distinct because the factor is single-stock, same-session and one-day only
full_family_review.quarterly_quality_listing_and_daily_meta: distinct because no quarterly, listing, turnover or daily value enters
full_family_review.full_library_consensus_families: distinct because no terminal component, score, rank consensus or combination enters
